text: grenke is the brand of grenke AG (Baden-Baden), an SDAX-listed leasing and factoring company. The founding family's Grenke Beteiligung GmbH & Co. KG (owned by Anneliese Grenke, founder Wolfgang Grenke and their sons) held 40.84 percent of the shares as of 31 December 2024; the GRENKE Foundation held 3.03 percent, treasury shares 4.98 percent, and the free float was 59.16 percent. No state shareholder is reported.
short: grenke AG is SDAX-listed; founding-family holding 40.84%, free float 59.16%, no state owner.

source.name: grenke AG — Annual Report 2024, To our shareholders / Shareholder structure
source.quote: As of December 31, 2024, Grenke Beteiligung GmbH & Co. KG held 40.84 percent of the Company’s shares, while the GRENKE Foundation owned 3.03 percent.
